---
title: "Where Should I Start?"
---

- **Never programmed before:** start with Module 0 (setup) and Module 1 (Python essentials).
- **Already use Stata or R:** skim Module 1 and begin with Module 2 (pandas).
- **Comfortable with pandas and basic plotting:** work through Module 4 (applied econometrics), after reviewing Module 3 as needed.
- **Want reproducible research workflows:** proceed to Module 6 after the core data and econometrics skills.

This guide maps *planned* lessons; the course is not yet published in full.
